summary: Genco Shipping & Trading Limited filed an 8-K regarding a Second Amendment to its Shareholder Rights Agreement (poison pill). The amendment rescinds a prior amendment and raises the beneficial ownership threshold to become an Acquiring Person from 10% to 15% for all shareholders, effective May 1, 2026. The Rights Agreement, originally dated October 1, 2025, remains in effect to protect shareholder value against open-market accumulations without a control premium. This is a routine governance update, not a special situation event. No deal terms, share prices, or transaction mechanics apply.
